title: index.json -- repo inventory and cross-unit dependency graph
$comment: Phase 2 output. Produced by `node tools/resolve.mjs index <src-root>`. One record per Angular unit in the source tree; dependency edges come from both import statements and template selector usage. The processingOrder array is a leaf-first topological sort so that a unit's dependencies are already documented when it is processed. Units involved in import cycles are appended after the sort and noted in warnings.

srcRoot.$comment: Path of the Angular source root relative to the project root directory.

processingOrder.$comment: Leaf-first: dependencies come before their dependents. Units in a cycle appear at the end. Process in this order so a unit's dependencies are already documented when it is reached.

reverseDependencies.$comment: Map from unitId to the list of unitIds that directly depend on it. Lets consumedBy be populated from fact rather than inference.

warnings.$comment: Non-fatal issues encountered during indexing. Reported rather than silently dropped.

path.$comment: Directory path relative to srcRoot (forward slashes).

via.$comment: 'import' = TypeScript import statement; 'selector' = child component used in template.

declaredPaths.$comment: Path strings declared in Routes arrays in this file. Lazy-loaded children are not followed.

kind.$comment: Whether this was an unresolved import path or an unresolved template selector.

ref.$comment: The raw import path or selector string that could not be resolved.
